item.content:encoded:
A bit conflicted on this one. I thought the pictures were pretty funny, and some of the lines got a chuckle out of me. On the other hand, some of the lines feel like they're trying way too hard to be goofy and wacky, in particular this line:

so CLOSE THE GODDAMN WINDOW BEFORE MTF OMEGA-99 SEES YOU and have a nice fucking day! :D :D :D

and I'd suggest that they be toned down a bit. I remember seeing a comment similar to this in the draft thread you posted for this skip, which, if I recall correctly, was only up for a day or two before this was posted. I know it's been said many times, but I strongly recommend that you take a bit more time with each draft to make sure that they're the best they can be. Neutral voting for now, but that could easily change with a quick rework.
E: With the recent, edit, I can definitely upvote this. Thanks, dave.
